topic: KNOWN DEFECT C2: doi status sang completed khong goi API thanh toan nao va khong co chan thao tac nham
statement: Theo tai lieu `known issues edge cases` Section: C2, doi status 1 invoice tu pending thang sang completed KHONG he goi bat ky API PayPal/ngan hang nao - he thong chi ghi nhan admin 'khai bao' da thanh toan va CHAP NHAN BINH THUONG viec doi status cho 1 invoice ma chua thuc su chuyen tien. Affiliate van nhan duoc email 'thanh toan hoan tat' du chua nhan tien thuc. KHONG co gi o tang code chan thao tac nham (quen chuyen tien ma doi status, hoac chuyen tien roi quen doi status). Day la hanh vi hien tai cua he thong (rui ro nam hoan toan o quy trinh con nguoi) - giu OBSERVED_CURRENT, KHONG duoc nang len CONFIRMED_EXPECTED.
